title: Road-surface height prior for gnss_solve (PLATEAU / GSI DEM)
reference_use: The reference trajectory is used only for scoring and the analysis-only phase audit. Maps, antenna offsets and sigmas come from PLATEAU / GSI data and from each run's own U solution.

frozen_rules.text:
Frozen 2026-10-28 before the replay. Local experiment (not pushed) on 4f4282f + the opt-in road-height prior
(RTKConfig::road_height_sigma_m; gnss_solve --road-height-map/--road-height-sigma-m/--road-height-offset-m;
binary bin_rh/gnss_solve sha256 eefd0964...). Flag off: --preset urban POS byte-identical on tokyo/run1 and Trimble Odaiba.
Runs: the seven Tokyo runs (PPC tokyo/run1-3, Trimble and u-blox Odaiba and Shinjuku). Nagoya has no PLATEAU road heights.
Map per run (truth-free): PLATEAU LOD3 tran road surfaces (車道部, 車道交差部) of the Chiyoda, Chuo, Minato, Koto,
Shinagawa, Shinjuku and Shibuya wards plus the MLIT road set, all leaf tiles; sampled on a 1 m grid within 30 m of the
run's own U solution (any status); nodes whose surfaces disagree by > 0.5 m dropped.
Offset and sigma per run from U's FIX epochs on the map: offset = median(FIX height - road height),
sigma_MAD = 1.4826 * MAD. The reference trajectory is used only for scoring and the phase audit.
Recipes: U = --preset urban; UR = U + map + offset + sigma max(sigma_MAD, 0.10) (primary); UR30 = U + map + offset +
sigma 0.30 (sensitivity, roughly the vertical spec of large-scale maps). Radius 1.5 m.
Metrics per run: PPC official score (3D <= 0.5 m, distance weighted; PPC runs), share of epochs within 0.5 m 3D,
FIX, audited wrong FIX >0.5 m, U-correct FIX lost, missing epochs, Hp95, Vp95.
Prediction for UR: the official score rises on all three PPC runs (post-hoc height replacement alone gave +2.4 / +0.9
on run1 / run2); audited wrong FIX do not rise by more than 10% on any run; Vp95 falls on every run.

Frozen 2026-10-29 after the UR/UR30 replay (frozen_rule_road.txt, sha256 17431c38...) and before this replay.
Binary bin_rh2/gnss_solve sha256 c56afe5811998ef1... (exp/road-height-prior + prior v2).
Seen before freezing: on tokyo/run3 the prior was applied in epochs with no satellites (TOW 180561.2, innovation 32 m)
and the float stayed 0.48 m off where truth sat 0.16 m above road+offset; on Trimble Odaiba the constrained float
fixed into a 0.27 m horizontal basin that drifted to +0.5 m up.
Prior v2: applied after a successful float update and before AR, at the float position; variance =
sigma^2 + (road gradient . horizontal covariance); no prior in epochs without an update. Optional fix check
(--road-height-fix-max-sigmas k): reject an AR or hold candidate whose height is more than k*sigma off road+offset.
Maps, offsets and sigmas: unchanged from frozen_rule_road.txt (sigma = max(1.4826 MAD, 0.10)). k = 3 (conventional).
Recipes: UR2 = U + map + prior v2; UR2F = UR2 + --road-height-fix-max-sigmas 3 (primary).
Prediction for UR2F vs U: the PPC official score rises on all three PPC runs; audited wrong FIX >0.5 m do not exceed
U's count by more than max(10%, 2) on any run; Vp95 falls on every run.

Frozen 2026-10-29 after the UR2/UR2F replay (frozen_rule_road2.txt, sha256 abdc902f...) and before this replay.
Binary bin_rh3/gnss_solve sha256 8be327b1215a7665...
Seen before freezing: UR2 (prior after the float update) fixed tokyo/run3 and Odaiba but raised Shinjuku wrong FIX
119 -> 219 and u-blox Shinjuku 3 -> 108; the fix check (UR2F) rejected 989 / 1254 U-correct FIX on tokyo/run2 / run3.
Prior v3: applied before the float update as in UR, but only in epochs that reach the update (satellite data
collected, >= 4 satellites), at the re-seeded position, with variance sigma^2 + (road gradient . seed horizontal
covariance). No fix check. Maps, offsets and sigmas unchanged.
Recipe: UR3 = U + map + prior v3.
Prediction for UR3 vs U: the PPC official score rises on all three PPC runs; audited wrong FIX >0.5 m do not exceed
U's count by more than max(10%, 2) on any run; Vp95 falls on every run.
Whatever the result, adoption needs a held-out check on data not used here (planned: PPC Nagoya with a GSI DEM map).

Frozen 2026-10-29 before the replay. Held-out check of the road-height prior on PPC nagoya/run1-3, which were not used
to design any prior variant (only U's Nagoya outputs existed; no prior run on Nagoya before this).
Map per run (truth-free): GSI DEM5A (z15 dem5a_png tiles chosen from the run's U solution extent), orthometric height
+ geoid from a plane fitted to five GSI geoid-calculation points, sampled on a 1 m grid within 30 m of the run's
U solution (inverse-distance weighting of the 4 nearest DEM pixels). No multilevel removal is possible with a DEM.
Offset and sigma from U's FIX epochs as on Tokyo: sigma = max(1.4826 MAD, 0.10).
Recipes: U; UR3 (prior v3, bin_rh3, primary); UR (prior v1, bin_rh, secondary).
Prediction for UR3 vs U on the three Nagoya runs: the mean PPC official score rises; summed audited wrong FIX >0.5 m
rise by at most 10%; Vp95 falls on at least two of the three runs.

Frozen 2026-10-29 after the Nagoya held-out replay (frozen_rule_road_nagoya.txt, sha256 c271ac14...) and before this replay.
Binary bin_rhp/gnss_solve sha256 aebefd66... (exp/road-height-prior + --road-height-publish-only).
Seen before freezing: on Nagoya UR3 raised the official score mean 40.2 -> 47.3% but audited wrong FIX 54 -> 199.
URP = U + map + --road-height-publish-only: after the float update the road-height update (v3 variance) is applied to a
copy of the state used only for the published FLOAT; the filter and AR keep the GNSS-only state. The published FLOAT
also enters the solution history (rememberSolution), so later gates see it.
Maps, offsets and sigmas unchanged (Tokyo: PLATEAU; Nagoya: GSI DEM).
Runs: the seven Tokyo runs and the three Nagoya runs.
Prediction for URP vs U: summed audited wrong FIX >0.5 m within +5% over the ten runs and no run above U by more than
max(10%, 2); FIX within +-1% of U on every run; the mean official score rises over Tokyo and over Nagoya.

recipes.UR: v1 (historical, not in the code): prior right after the kinematic re-seed in every epoch, at the seed, variance sigma^2
recipes.UR2: v2 (historical): prior after the float update, at the float position, slope-aware variance
recipes.UR2F: UR2 + fixed-height check at 3 sigma (historical; the option is not in the code)
recipes.UR3: v3 = the in-filter mode in the code: --road-height-map --road-height-sigma-m --road-height-offset-m
recipes.URP: publish-only mode in the code: UR3 flags + --road-height-publish-only

map_tool: scripts/experiments/road_height/road_height_maps.py rebuilds all ten maps byte-identically (plateau-map / dem-map)

scoring.official_pct: apps/commands/benchmarks/gnss_ppc_metrics.py ppc_official_distance_score() (3D <= 0.5 m, distance weighted; tolerance 0.25 s, u-blox 6 ms)
scoring.u_correct_lost: U FIX within 0.5 m that are not FIX within 0.5 m under the recipe

URP.summed audited wrong within +5% and no r: held (249 -> 248; every run equal or one lower)
URP.FIX within +-1% on every run: failed by 0.03 pp on u-blox Shinjuku (+1.03%, more FIX)

mechanisms.v1_no_satellite_epochs: tokyo/run3 TOW 180561.2: the prior was applied in an epoch with no satellites (innovation 32 m); the float then stayed 0.48 m off where truth sat 0.16 m above road + offset
mechanisms.v2_after_update: with the prior after the float update the code outliers are no longer rejected against a height-constrained prediction; Shinjuku wrong FIX 119 -> 219, u-blox Shinjuku 3 -> 108
mechanisms.fixed_height_check: rejected 989 / 1254 U-correct FIX on tokyo/run2 / run3 where the map is locally off; not kept
mechanisms.in_filter_wrong_fix: new FIX under UR3 (not FIX under U): 5659, of which 78 audited wrong (1.4%, against about 0.16% for U's own FIX); post-fix residuals, AFn and ratio do not separate them (post-fix RMS > 0.10 m catches 23 of 35 wrong AR fixes but rejects 10% of the correct new ones)
mechanisms.publish_only: the filter and AR keep the GNSS-only state, so FIX and wrong FIX stay at U; the published FLOAT (and the solution history) take the height update

decision: Both modes stay opt-in and nothing changes by default or in --preset urban. The publish-only mode is the recommended one: it never raised wrong FIX on the ten runs. The in-filter mode raises the score more (Tokyo +5.0 pp, Nagoya +7.2 pp mean) at the cost of wrong FIX (Nagoya 54 -> 199).
